summary.zh: 11 点全部投入射击系直取独来独往：不召唤宠物时伤害提高 20%，另有暴击与智力转攻强加成。
summary.en: Eleven points straight down Marksmanship for Lone Wolf: 20% more damage while no pet is active, on top of crit and Attack Power from Intellect.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，不带宠物时的地下城与 AoE 最高输出
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, maximum dungeon and AoE damage with no pet out

pros.zh: 致命攻击提供 5% 全攻击暴击几率。
pros.en: Lethal Attacks adds 5% critical strike chance with all attacks.

pros.zh: 精确瞄准把 100% 智力转化为攻击强度，而早期的皮甲与锁甲上智力并不稀缺。
pros.en: Careful Aim converts 100% of your Intellect into Attack Power, and Intellect is plentiful on the leather and mail you find early.

pros.zh: 独来独往让没有宠物时的伤害提高 20%，这也是在这个等级段一路点到底的唯一理由。
pros.en: Lone Wolf adds 20% damage while you have no active pet, which is the whole point of going this deep this early.

pros.zh: 这是地下城方案，不是练级方案。在野外，野兽控制能同时保留宠物、急速触发和移动速度。
pros.en: This is a dungeon build, not a questing one. Out in the world, Beast Mastery keeps the pet, the haste proc and the run speed.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
